See what the cost estimate includes

See the full score breakdown

Score = sum of (rating ÷ 5 × weight share × 100). Weights follow your priority. Cost rating = lowest running cost ÷ this city’s running cost × 5, where running cost is salaries, benefits and office rent. The score measures this scenario, not the cities themselves.
